name: LatentTools reference attention guidance
plain: Runs the model on a noised reference latent to capture attention, then runs it again on the real latent with that attention transferred in at chosen blocks, and uses the difference as an extra term. The node is named DownsampledLatentGuidance, but the downsample code is commented out at this version. That makes it three extra cond calls per step.
math:
x_r=y·scale+σ·n. Call 1 cond(x_r). Call 2 on x_r stores attention. Call 3 cond(x) with copied attention.
x̂=c+(s−1)(c−u)+w(c_mod−c).

props.params: downscaling_factor=2 (unused by the active code path),guidance weight,unet blocks

label: from code
surprise: Named downsampled guidance while the downscale and upscale lines are comments; it now feeds a re-noised reference latent.
